keys.manual_admin.page.title: XIRO! - Administrator Manual
keys.manual_admin.hero.title: Administrator Manual
keys.manual_admin.hero.subtitle: Everything you need to manage XIRO! from the administration panel
keys.manual_admin.access.login.title: Access the admin panel
keys.manual_admin.access.login.p1: Go to xiro.pro/admin.html or click the «Administration» card on the home page. Enter the administrator password to log in.
keys.manual_admin.access.login.p2: The session remains open in the browser until you log out manually or clear the browser storage.
keys.manual_admin.access.roles.title: User roles
keys.manual_admin.access.roles.admin_desc: Full access: management of banks, games, trivial, custom, server tools and configuration panel.
keys.manual_admin.access.roles.editor_desc: Can create and edit content (banks, games, trivial, custom) but has no access to server tools or advanced configuration.
keys.manual_admin.access.nav.title: Panel navigation
keys.manual_admin.access.nav.intro: The panel has a left sidebar with four main sections:
keys.manual_admin.access.nav.games: Question Mix — Games generated by mixing banks
keys.manual_admin.access.nav.trivial: Trivial — Trivial-style games organised by colour categories
keys.manual_admin.access.search.title: Search questions
keys.manual_admin.access.search.p1: The search bar at the top of the sidebar lets you search for questions across all banks at once. Type at least 2 characters to see results.
keys.manual_admin.access.search.p2: From the results you can navigate directly to the bank containing the question to edit it.
keys.manual_admin.banks.create.title: Create and edit a bank
keys.manual_admin.banks.create.s1: Click Question Banks in the side menu.
keys.manual_admin.banks.create.s2: Click «Add New Bank». Give it a name and optionally a PIN so presenters can use it directly.
keys.manual_admin.banks.create.s3: Click «Add question» to create questions. Select the question type on each card.
keys.manual_admin.banks.create.s4: Click «Save bank» when you are done.
keys.manual_admin.banks.types.title: Question types
keys.manual_admin.banks.types.quiz: Quiz — Multiple choice with one correct answer. You can add a justification to each option.
keys.manual_admin.banks.types.numeric: Numeric — The player enters a number. Configure exact, percentage or rounding tolerance.
keys.manual_admin.banks.types.scramble: Letter scramble — Scrambled letters are shown; the player reconstructs the correct word.
keys.manual_admin.banks.types.order: Order elements — The player drags elements into the correct order.
keys.manual_admin.banks.media.title: Add multimedia to questions
keys.manual_admin.banks.media.intro: Each question can have an attached resource. Inside the question editor, select the content type:
keys.manual_admin.banks.media.image: Image — JPG, PNG, GIF or WebP. Maximum 5 MB. Drag the file or click to select.
keys.manual_admin.banks.media.audio: Audio — MP3, WAV or OGG. Maximum 10 MB. Plays automatically when the question is shown.
keys.manual_admin.banks.media.url: External URL — Direct link to an image or audio hosted outside the server.
keys.manual_admin.banks.slides.title: Special slides
keys.manual_admin.banks.slides.intro: In addition to regular questions, you can insert special slides, but only inside a custom game (not available in a question bank):
keys.manual_admin.banks.slides.comment_text: Used for the presenter to manually score a free-form answer (debate, oral question, etc.). Players see a waiting screen.
keys.manual_admin.banks.slides.info_text: Displays content (text, image or audio) without scoring. Ideal for introducing topics or showing partial results.
keys.manual_admin.banks.streaks.title: Streak configuration
keys.manual_admin.banks.streaks.intro: Each bank allows configuring a streak bonus system. Enable it in the bank's advanced settings section:
keys.manual_admin.banks.streaks.simple_text: Set a consecutive correct answer threshold (e.g. 3) and a bonus % on top of normal points. A wrong answer resets the streak.
keys.manual_admin.banks.streaks.double_text: A second, higher threshold unlocks an additional bonus. Useful for rewarding the most consistent players with tiered bonuses.
keys.manual_admin.games.mix.title: Question mix
keys.manual_admin.games.mix.intro: A Mix game randomly combines questions from several banks into a single session.
keys.manual_admin.games.mix.s1: Go to Question Mix and click «Add New Game».
keys.manual_admin.games.mix.s2: Give it a name, configure the number of questions per bank and select the banks you want to mix.
keys.manual_admin.games.mix.s3: The generated game shows a PIN that the presenter enters to start it.
keys.manual_admin.games.custom.title: Custom games
keys.manual_admin.games.custom.intro: A custom game lets you choose exactly which questions appear and in what order, freely mixing questions from different banks.
keys.manual_admin.games.custom.select: Select questions from any bank using the side panel selector.
keys.manual_admin.games.custom.comment: Interleave comment slides to add debates or pauses with manual scoring.
keys.manual_admin.games.custom.pdf: Export to PDF — Generates a printable PDF with all questions and correct answers. Available from the games list and from the editor.
keys.manual_admin.games.trivial.title: Trivial mode
keys.manual_admin.games.trivial.intro: A trivial game is organised into up to 6 categories, each with a different colour (represented as a wedge of the pie). Teams accumulate wedges by answering correctly.
keys.manual_admin.games.trivial.create_text: Go to Trivial → «New Trivial». Define the name and add categories with their colours.
keys.manual_admin.games.trivial.categories_te: Each category has a customisable colour and an assigned question bank. You can see the colours in the list with colour swatches.
keys.manual_admin.games.trivial.config_text: Define whether the game requires all wedges to win, or whether it is played by time or number of rounds.
keys.manual_admin.export.json_exp.title: Export bank to JSON
keys.manual_admin.export.json_exp.text: From the editor of an already saved bank, click the «Export bank» button (top button bar). A .json file with the bank name and all its questions will be downloaded.
keys.manual_admin.export.json_exp.info: The button only appears if the bank has an assigned ID (i.e. it has been saved at least once).
keys.manual_admin.export.json_exp.note: The exported file is compatible with the importer and with external tools to edit the bank offline.
keys.manual_admin.export.json_imp.title: Import bank from JSON
keys.manual_admin.export.json_imp.s1: At the bottom of the sidebar click the «Load Questions» button.
keys.manual_admin.export.json_imp.s2: Drag your .json file to the upload area (or click to select it). A preview is shown with the bank name and the number of detected questions.
keys.manual_admin.export.json_imp.s3: Optionally enter a PIN for the bank. If left empty, a 6-digit one is generated automatically.
keys.manual_admin.export.json_imp.s4: Click «Create bank». The system will import all questions and redirect to the banks list.
keys.manual_admin.export.pdf.title: Export game to PDF
keys.manual_admin.export.pdf.p1: Custom games can be exported as a printable PDF. The PDF includes all questions with their answer options and the correct answer marked.
keys.manual_admin.export.pdf.from_list: From the custom games list click the PDF icon on the game card.
keys.manual_admin.export.pdf.from_editor: From the game editor click the «Export to PDF» button.
keys.manual_admin.export.pdf.note: The PDF is generated on the server and downloaded automatically. Only available for already saved games.
keys.manual_admin.export.format.title: JSON file format
keys.manual_admin.export.format.text: The JSON file of a bank follows this structure. You can create or edit it with any text editor:
keys.manual_admin.export.format.note: You can view the full schema at /data/schema.json.
keys.manual_admin.export.format.example.quest: What is the capital of France?
keys.manual_admin.tools.server.title: Server tools
keys.manual_admin.tools.server.intro: Accessible from the «Config» tab in the side menu (only visible with admin role):
keys.manual_admin.tools.server.uploads_text: Removes uploaded media files that are no longer referenced by any question.
keys.manual_admin.tools.server.cache_text: Flushes the internal question bank cache. Useful if you have just edited a bank and the changes are not reflected in new games.
keys.manual_admin.tools.server.logs_text: Removes the server log files to free up space.
keys.manual_admin.tools.panic.title: Restart and PANIC
keys.manual_admin.tools.panic.panic_text: Forced restart of the Docker container. Use only in emergencies. All active games are interrupted. Requires confirmation before executing.
keys.manual_admin.tools.config.title: Configuration panel
keys.manual_admin.tools.config.intro: The configuration panel allows adjusting game parameters in real time without restarting the server. Changes take effect immediately for new games.
keys.manual_admin.tools.config.times_text: Adjust the default times for the different question types.
keys.manual_admin.tools.config.scoring_text: Configure base points, penalties and speed bonuses.
keys.manual_admin.tools.config.visibility_tex: Control which question banks the presenter can see from their game selection screen.
keys.manual_admin.remote.access.title: How to access
keys.manual_admin.remote.access.intro: The remote control lets you manage a game projected on a PC from your phone or another device, without needing to be in front of the main computer.
keys.manual_admin.remote.access.s1: Log in to the admin panel with the Admin role.
keys.manual_admin.remote.access.s2: Go to the Config tab in the side menu.
keys.manual_admin.remote.access.s3: Find the Active Games section. You will see the list of currently active sessions.
keys.manual_admin.remote.access.s4: Click the «Control» button for the session you want to manage. The remote control screen will open.
keys.manual_admin.remote.access.info: You can open this screen on any device connected to the same network. If the session has already ended, the button will not appear.
keys.manual_admin.remote.buttons.title: Control buttons
keys.manual_admin.remote.buttons.intro: The remote interface shows a status bar at the top and three main action buttons:
keys.manual_admin.remote.buttons.next_text: The main button changes its label according to the state: Start in the lobby, Next during the game and Continue after revealing the answer.
keys.manual_admin.remote.buttons.reveal_text: Shows the correct answer and stops the timer.
keys.manual_admin.remote.buttons.end_text: Ends the session and shows the podium. Requires confirmation before executing.
keys.manual_admin.remote.buttons.finish_text: Visible only after revealing the last question. Takes you directly to the final podium.
keys.manual_admin.remote.timer.title: The timer
keys.manual_admin.remote.timer.p1: Above the control buttons a circular timer appears, synchronised in real time with the main presenter screen. It shows the remaining seconds for the active question.
keys.manual_admin.remote.timer.p2: Tap the circle to pause or resume the timer. The change is reflected instantly on all screens.
keys.manual_admin.remote.timer.note: The timer disappears automatically when the answer is revealed.
keys.manual_admin.remote.security.title: Security and tips
keys.manual_admin.remote.security.protected_t: The remote screen only works with a valid admin token. If someone knows the URL but does not have the token, the server rejects the connection.
keys.manual_admin.remote.security.compatible_: The remote control and the main presenter can be active simultaneously without interfering. Both control the same session.
keys.manual_admin.remote.security.tip_text: Open the remote control on your phone before starting the game. This way you join the session from the lobby and receive all events from the beginning, including the timer for the first question.
keys.manual_admin.access.account.title: My account
keys.manual_admin.access.account.p1: In the User tab of the sidebar you can see your account details (username, email and role) and manage your security.
keys.manual_admin.access.account.password: Change password — enter the current password, the new one and its confirmation.
keys.manual_admin.access.account.email: Change email — the current email does not change until you confirm the link sent to the new address.
keys.manual_admin.access.users.title: Manage users
keys.manual_admin.access.users.p1: Admin-only panel to review the panel accounts: username, email, role, status and registration date.
keys.manual_admin.access.users.p2: From here you can delete accounts. User deletion is permanent and cannot be undone.
keys.manual_admin.banks.types.survey: Survey — Players vote between options and the results are shown; there is no correct answer.
keys.manual_admin.banks.types.matching: Matching — Two columns; the player links each item with its correct pair (up to 6 pairs).
keys.manual_admin.banks.ai.title: AI question generator
keys.manual_admin.banks.ai.intro: Create a full bank automatically from AI Generator in the sidebar. Requires a configured Groq or Gemini API key (Tools → AI).
keys.manual_admin.banks.ai.s1: Source — upload a document (.pdf, .docx, .txt) or type the topic to generate questions about.
keys.manual_admin.banks.ai.s2: Configure — name the bank and choose the difficulty (low, medium or high).
keys.manual_admin.banks.ai.s3: Result — review the generated questions, regenerate the types with errors and press "Import bank" or "Download JSON".
keys.manual_admin.banks.merge.title: Merge banks
keys.manual_admin.banks.merge.intro: The "Merge Banks" button in the bank list combines questions from several banks into a new one.
keys.manual_admin.banks.merge.s1: Select at least 2 banks from the list (or use "Select all").
keys.manual_admin.banks.merge.s2: Name the new bank and, optionally, give it a PIN.
keys.manual_admin.banks.merge.s3: Press "Create Merged Bank". The original banks are not modified.
keys.manual_admin.banks.visibility.title: Visibility for the presenter
keys.manual_admin.banks.visibility.intro: Every bank, mix, custom game or trivial has a "Show to presenter" toggle in its edit form. On top of that, the header of each listing (Banks, Mix, Custom, Trivial) includes two quick buttons:
keys.manual_admin.banks.visibility.hide_text: Instantly hides every item in that list from the presenter.
keys.manual_admin.banks.visibility.show_text: Shows all of them to the presenter again at once.
keys.manual_admin.banks.visibility.scope_note: An editor only affects the resources they created; an admin affects everyone's in the list.
